content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Lansing

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's current eligibility criteria to verify you meet both the educational background and hours of documented project leadership. Granite PM Academy can guide you through this verification step before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals in the Lansing area. Our experienced instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours on a schedule that fits your work commitments while building the knowledge foundation needed for exam success.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your formal training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides clear guidance on the application process and documentation requirements so your submission is complete and timely.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and review sessions, to reinforce key concepts and test-taking strategies. When you're ready, schedule your exam at a Lansing-area testing center and demonstrate your project-management competency to earn the PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMI credentials require renewal every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you meet renewal requirements while staying current with evolving project-management practices and industry standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
